advancedPage.title: Advanced features
advancedPage.warning: Changing policy may affect an agent's network access. Keep the defaults if you are unfamiliar with these fields.
advancedPage.mitmHint: Precise session, process, domain scope, and short-lived CA support are complete. HTTPS data plane, macOS/Windows trust stores, pre-connect blocking, QUIC, and certificate pinning acceptance are unfinished. Until then, content is not shown as protected and no system certificate is installed.

developer.title: Developer mode
developer.description: Record request processing and redaction decisions to investigate false positives. Off by default.

developer.empty: Enable developer mode and make a request to see the five most recent traces here.
